title: Unemployment Benefit Claims Weekly Benefit Terms: Waiting Week, Earnings Disregard, Full-Time Hours and Other Pay
content:
The program figures that a certified week of an Unemployment Benefit Claims record is measured against are scheduled here for every program.

| Program | Waiting week count (weeks) | Disregard share of the weekly benefit amount | Full-time hours threshold (hours) | Vacation pay deductible | Holiday pay deductible | Severance pay deductible | Pension offset share (pension wholly financed by a base-period employer) | Claimant-contributed share (pension the claimant paid into) |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Regular State Unemployment Insurance | 1 | 0.30 | 32 | Yes | Yes | No | 1.00 | 0.50 |
| Unemployment Compensation for Federal Employees (UCFE) | 1 | 0.30 | 32 | Yes | Yes | No | 1.00 | 0.50 |
| Unemployment Compensation for Ex-Servicemembers (UCX) | 1 | 0.30 | 32 | Yes | Yes | No | 1.00 | 0.50 |
| Combined Wage Claim (CWC) | 1 | 0.30 | 32 | Yes | Yes | No | 1.00 | 0.50 |
| Extended Benefits (EB) | 0 | 0.30 | 32 | Yes | Yes | No | 1.00 | 0.50 |
| Trade Readjustment Allowances (TRA) | 0 | 0.30 | 32 | Yes | Yes | No | 1.00 | 0.50 |
| Disaster Unemployment Assistance (DUA) | 0 | 0.30 | 32 | Yes | Yes | No | 1.00 | 0.50 |

## What each column means

- **Waiting week count:** the number of otherwise-payable weeks at the start of the benefit year served as unpaid waiting weeks.
- **Disregard share:** the share of the weekly benefit amount (0.30, that is 30 percent) that weekly gross earnings may reach before any reduction.
- **Full-time hours threshold:** the hours worked in a week at or above which the claimant is not unemployed for that week.
- **Vacation, holiday and severance pay deductible:** whether that kind of pay allocated to a certified week is deducted from that week's benefit.
- **Pension offset share and claimant-contributed share:** the share of the weekly-prorated pension deducted from the weekly benefit; the first applies to a pension wholly financed by a base-period employer, the second where the claimant contributed to the plan.

### Hypothetical figure

For a hypothetical weekly benefit amount of 400.00, the disregard share of 0.30 gives a disregard of 120.00; this is an illustration of the share only.
